summary: Adaptive Biotechnologies files 8-K announcing intention to separate its MRD and Immune Medicine businesses. Also proposes $250M convertible senior notes offering (with $37.5M greenshoe) to repurchase $25M common stock, fund capped call, and repay OrbiMed. No definitive terms or timeline for the separation, board recommendation, or advisors provided. The notes are offered to QIBs under Rule 144A. The convertible offering provides financing flexibility. Watch for further details on separation structure, regulatory approvals, and any impact from note conversion dilution.
